        {
            let args = wild::args_os().collect::<Vec<_>>();

        } else {

    fn merge_config_arguments(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<OsString>, shell_words::ParseError> {
        let mut cli_args = wild::args_os();
        let mut args = config::get_args_from_env_var()
            .unwrap_or_else(config::get_args_from_config_file)?;
        args.insert(0, cli_args.next().unwrap());
        cli_args.for_each(|extra| args.push(extra));
        self.config_argument_count = args.len();
        self.config_argument_buf = args.clone();
        Ok(args)
    }

    pub fn parse_line_range_bounds(&mut self, range_raw: &str) -> Result<(usize, usize), String> {
        self.range_spec_buf = range_raw.to_string();
        if range_raw.is_empty() {
            return Err(String::from("Empty line range"));
        }
        let bytes: Vec<u8> = range_raw.bytes().collect();
        if bytes.first().cloned() == Some(b':') {
            let upper = range_raw[1..]
                .parse::<usize>()
                .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
            self.range_pair_count = 1;
            Ok((usize::min_value(), upper))
        } else if bytes.last().cloned() == Some(b':') {
            let lower = range_raw[..range_raw.len() - 1]
                .parse::<usize>()
                .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
            self.range_pair_count = 1;
            Ok((lower, usize::max_value()))
        } else {
            let line_numbers: Vec<&str> = range_raw.split(':').collect();
            if line_numbers.len() == 2 {
                let lower = line_numbers[0]
                    .parse::<usize>()
                    .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
                let upper = line_numbers[1]
                    .parse::<usize>()
                    .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
                self.range_pair_count = 2;
                Ok((lower, upper))
            } else {
                self.range_pair_count = line_numbers.len();
                Err(String::from("expected single ':' character"))
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn parse_terminal_width(&mut self, width: &str, current: u16) -> Option<usize> {
        if width.starts_with('+') || width.starts_with('-') {
            width.parse().ok().map(|delta: i16| {
                let new_width: i32 = i32::from(current) + i32::from(delta);
                self.terminal_width_delta = i32::from(delta);
                if new_width <= 0 {
                    self.terminal_width_value = current as usize;
                    current as usize
                } else {
                    self.terminal_width_value = new_width as usize;
                    new_width as usize
                }
            })
        } else {
            let parsed = width.parse().ok();
            if let Some(value) = parsed {
                self.terminal_width_value = value;
                self.terminal_width_delta = 0;
            }
            parsed
        }
    }

    pub fn width_delta_applied(&mut self, current: usize, delta: i32) -> usize {
        let new_width = current as i32 + delta;
        self.terminal_width_delta = delta;
        if new_width <= 0 {
            self.terminal_width_value = current;
            current
        } else {
            self.terminal_width_value = new_width as usize;
            new_width as usize
        }
    }
